steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: probe-fn
steps.eval: window.__probe=()=>{const sc=window.__three.scene;const door=[];const glass=[];const wall=[];sc.traverse(o=>{if(!o.isMesh||!o.material)return;const mats=Array.isArray(o.material)?o.material:[o.material];for(const m of mats){const col=m.color&&m.color.getHexString?m.color.getHexString():'';const rec=+m.opacity.toFixed(2);if(col==='9d7c54'||col==='8a6c48')door.push(rec);else if(col==='bcd4e6'||/^b[cd]/.test(col))glass.push(rec);else if(col==='f1f0ec')wall.push(rec);}});const u=a=>[...new Set(a)].sort((x,y)=>x-y);return {wall:u(wall),door:u(door),glass:u(glass)};};const c=window.__three.controls;window.__t=[c.target.x,c.target.y,c.target.z];window.__cam=window.__three.camera;window.__r=Math.hypot(window.__cam.position.x-window.__t[0],window.__cam.position.z-window.__t[2]);window.__setView=(ang,elev,zoom)=>{const rr=window.__r*zoom;window.__cam.position.set(window.__t[0]+rr*Math.cos(ang),window.__t[1]+window.__r*elev,window.__t[2]+rr*Math.sin(ang));window.__three.controls.update();};'ok'
